issues.description: patch_description uses hyphens as word separators instead of spaces. Rule 12 (Code Style section 12 补丁文件规范) requires: 'patch_description 用空格分隔（非连字符）'. Current value: "0001-Fix-cmake_minimum_required-VERSION-3.0-to-3.5-for-CMake-4.x-compatibility" — all words are hyphen-separated.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change patch_description to use spaces instead of hyphens, e.g.: "0001 Fix cmake_minimum_required VERSION 3.0 to 3.5 for CMake 4.x compatibility"
